service.name: dev.avyos.settings
service.description: Persistent key/value settings service used by desktop and system apps.

types.name: Empty
types.description: Empty payload used where no data is required.

types.name: KeyRequest
types.description: Lookup payload for a single settings key.

types.name: SetRequest
types.description: Write payload for a key/value update.

types.name: ListRequest
types.description: List query payload filtered by key prefix.

types.name: ChangedEvent
types.description: Event payload emitted when a value changes.

requests.name: RawGet
requests.description: Read a setting value by key.
requests.request_description: Contains the full key path to read.

requests.name: RawSet
requests.description: Write or update a setting value by key.
requests.request_description: Contains key and value to persist.

requests.name: RawList
requests.description: List settings entries with an optional prefix filter.
requests.request_description: Optional prefix to limit returned keys.

events.name: SettingsChanged
events.description: Published when a key is created or updated.
events.request_description: Contains changed key and new value.
